technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with short-term bullish structure (SMA cross, supertrend, hull) offset by weak trend confirmation (low ADX), negative money flow, and price below major moving averages—moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: IRM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 14 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (325), strong dollar pressures multinationals, credit stress evident, and earnings binary event in 14 days creates compounded downside risk for real estate sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross + supertrend bullish + hull bullish create short-term momentum structure in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support at 40.06.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 325, strong dollar, credit stress), price below 200-EMA, negative money flow, earnings binary in 14 days, and weak ADX trend confirmation create compounded downside risk that overwhelms technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows short-term bullish structure (SMA cross, supertrend) at support in extreme fear environment, but macro headwinds and earnings binary event within 14 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis + earnings event in 14 days create compounded recession/event risk; price below 200-EMA and negative money flow suggest weak institutional conviction despite technical cross.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical bullish vs. fundamental/macro/risk bearish; debate winner is bear with high confidence
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding IRM position + 22 other Real Estate positions (8.6% sector concentration); adding to existing IRM exposure during earnings window and macro stress violates concentration and event-risk discipline.
